verdict.rationale: Superhuman markets an AI-powered 'Ask AI' feature that promises rapid answers without needing to recall senders or keywords (docs-4, docs-18, docs-26), implying strong full-history search, but there is no documentation of classic power-user search operators, filters, or ranked full-text results. Hands-on community reports are split: one user reports search as 'blazing fast' (comm-9) while another ex-user explicitly says search through their email archive regularly took ten seconds vs. Gmail's instant results (comm-7), directly contradicting the speed claims. missing for 10: documented search operators/filter syntax, evidence of ranked search results, and consistent independent confirmation of search speed across full mail history.
